desc:
KUNAI DUELS is a fast, movement-heavy throwing game where every round comes down to one clean hit. Wall-run, slide and leap across the arena, and land your kunai before they land theirs. Fight in 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or 4v4: win the most rounds to take the match.

⚔️ Step onto a duel pad or hit PLAY DUELS to jump in!
🎯 Headshots, wall-run throws, mid-air kills: it's all skill!
🔪 Open cases for rare kunai skins, every one with its own serial number!
🤝 Trade kunai with other players!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards for wins, kills and win streaks!
🎁 New daily rewards and challenges every day!

Play on PC, phone, tablet or controller.

Enjoying it? A thumbs-up 👍 helps us more than you'd think!
🚫 Cheating or farming with alts = permanent ban. No appeals.
